grading: One point per supported criterion, maximum six; semantic review, not keyword matching. Count distinct incorrect or unsupported claims separately.

criteria.fact: Conversion occurs before validation; missing min/max leaves that direction unbounded, and closed endpoints are accepted.
min_open/max_open exclude equality at the corresponding endpoint.
With clamp=True, closed-bound violations return the violated bound instead of raising.
For IntRange open bounds, clamping moves one integer inward: min+1 or max-1.
Without clamping, out-of-range values fail with BadParameter and a range description; valid values are returned.
Identifies test_range and test_range_fail with accurate examples of accepted/clamped values and rejected bounds.
